text: The city would go on if the arcane went away, more slowly and less comfortably.

fold: The defenders at <N> make do: the town's workshops cannot keep them properly fed and equipped.
text: The defenders at Kulubtzal make do: the town's workshops cannot keep them properly fed and equipped.

fold: What <N> raises covers an ordinary year and no more, so # bad harvest would leave it short before spring.
text: What Radhawadi raises covers an ordinary year and no more, so one bad harvest would leave it short before spring.
why: says what the village raises covers an ordinary year; FOOD has grown 85% of need with a 6% gap and the page says it grows less than it eats

fold: The metropolis's record of crimes at <N> is neither short nor growing: the law and the criminals are close to even, and the next few seasons will decide which way it goes.
text: The metropolis's record of crimes at Erdenbuurt is neither short nor growing: the law and the criminals are close to even, and the next few seasons will decide which way it goes.
why: says crime is not growing and law and criminals are even; TENSIONS crime wave: crime rising faster than the authorities can answer; syndicate runs the town

fold: <N> has nobody to keep the peace, and trouble here is left for neighbours to settle between themselves.
text: Spitzthal has nobody to keep the peace, and trouble here is left for neighbours to settle between themselves.
why: says nobody keeps the peace; C23549 says the old families keep the peace and offenders answer to all the neighbours

fold: <N>'s accounts keep its town walls in repair but fall short on the watch's wages, so the defences stand and too few people man them.
text: Kulubtzal's accounts keep its town walls in repair but fall short on the watch's wages, so the defences stand and too few people man them.
